description: This file defines the interface DatatableReportExportService for exporting data table reports, including method signatures for exporting reports and checking support for export types.

classes.name: DatatableReportExportService
classes.description: Interface for exporting data table reports with methods to perform export and support checks.

methods.name: export
methods.description: Exports a report given report name, query parameters, report parameters, user report flag, and parameter type.

methods.name: supports
methods.description: Checks if a specific export type is supported.
